requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Get swatches of two natural fiber fabrics (100% cotton, linen, wool, or silk; no blends). Get swatches of two synthetic fiber fabrics (nylon, polyester, acrylic, olefin, or spandex). Get a sample of one cellulosic fabric (rayon, acetate, or lyocell). (b) Give the origin, major characteristics, and general content of each type of fiber obtained for 2(a). Explain the difference between a cellulosic manufactured fiber and a synthetic manufactured fiber. (c) Describe the main steps in making raw fiber into yarn, and yarn into fabric. (d) Assume you will soon buy a new garment or other textile item. Tell your counselor what fiber or blend of fibers you want the item to be, and give reasons for your choice.

requirements.req_text: Do TWO of the following: (a) Visit a textile plant, textile products manufacturer, or textile school or college. Report on what you saw and learned. (b) Weave a belt, headband, placemat, or wall hanging using a simple loom that you have made yourself. (c) With a magnifying glass, examine a woven fabric, a nonwoven fabric, and a knitted fabric. Sketch what you see. Explain how the three constructions are different. (d) Make a piece of felt. (e) Make two natural dyes and use them to dye a garment or a piece of fabric. (f) Waterproof a fabric. (g) Demonstrate how to identify fibers, using microscope identification or the breaking test.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 5): List the advantages and disadvantages of natural plant fibers, natural animal fibers, cellulosic manufactured fibers, and synthetic manufactured fibers.
Core Standard 2 (Req 5): Identify and discuss at least four ecological concerns regarding the production and care of textiles.
Safety & Policy Alignment: Follow the BSA Guide to Safe Scouting, Two-Deep Leadership, and the Buddy System during all Textile Req 5 activities.
Counselor Conference Readiness: Record concrete observations, examples, and sketches in your Textile Workbook before requesting Requirement 5 sign-off.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 5): Review the official Textile requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing List the advantages and disadvantages of natural plant.
Execute & Document: Perform the list task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Textile Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
